finalText:
**Redis died and took the service with it.** One cause, 17 minutes of fallout.

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:07 | Cache falls back to direct store reads |
| 02:14:10 | First `TimeoutError` after 5000ms, store overloaded |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth 502 passes the 500 cap |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` dies, `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| 02:31:52 | `FATAL [supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

All 13 reconnect tries failed, same `ECONNREFUSED`, 80s apart. Redis never came back. Everything else is noise from that.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused. Then cap the queue for real and bound the backlog so a cache loss cannot OOM the workers. See `[app.log:182](logs/app.log:182)`.
